I picked this up again when I was instore and immediately was reminded first wash why I loved it. Easy to use, effective, great for sensitive skin. Will repurchase again and again.

Pour 1/2 tsp into the cap and add a couple tablespoons of warm water. Let sit for a few minutes to dissolve. I usually use wash my face in the shower, so I do my other shower things while this sits for a few minutes. Mix liquid around with your finger for a few seconds, swishing the powder at the bottom of the cup around until competely dissolve. You'll notice soft bubbles (if not, add less water next time). Pour watery mixture into your palm and rub hands together to form gentle lather. Apply bubbles to face with circuluar motions, concentrating on areas in need most exfoliation. Then rinse. Enzymes are what make this product unqiue and effective (you'll have enough physical exfolitation just from rubbing it over your face). But I learned from K-beauty that enzymes need steam (like from a shower) to be activated on our skin. Grit be gone and hello soft, fresh face! I use this most days of the week and its never caused any issues with my rosacea and highly sensitive skin.
